title: Saving Recipients to a Personal Sender Account
content:
A recipient can be saved to a Personal Sender Account only while the account status is active.

## Caps on the recipient book

- The account may hold at most the level's number of saved recipients whose recipient status is active.
- The account may add at most the level's number of recipients in a rolling 30 calendar days, counted as the recipients added on the handling date or the 29 calendar days before it, including the new one.

A recipient beyond either cap is not saved until an existing one is removed in the app or the window frees.

## Corridor

A recipient's corridor decides which delivery methods and payout networks can serve them.

## Screening hold on a first transfer

For the level's screening-hold hours after a recipient is added, the first personal transfer to that recipient is held for screening before release. The hold is built into that transfer's disclosed date of availability and is never a late delivery.

## Hypothetical case

An account at Paloma Starter (at most 5 active saved recipients, at most 2 added in a rolling 30 calendar days) already added 2 recipients within the last 30 calendar days and holds 3 active recipients. A third recipient cannot be saved now, even though the active count is below 5: the 30-day cap is reached, and the recipient can be saved once the window frees.
